scenes.title: Biggest tire on a stock Toyota FJ Cruiser?
285/70R17 (about 33 x 11 in)
scenes.body: One owner's only rubbed the driver's-side mud flap under compression, cured by heating and flattening it.

scenes.title: 285/70R17
scenes.body: Slee told one owner this is the limit without body trimming; owners run it on factory wheels with no rub.

scenes.eyebrow: With a 3 in + body mount chop lift
scenes.title: 305/70R17 to 35 in
scenes.body: Owners run 305/70R17s and 34s with chopped mounts and plastic trim removed; one still rubs at full compression.

scenes.title: Every size, every lift.
scenes.body: Follow for a new truck every day.
